verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair axis for a CDP, since pipelines like warehouse syncs and audience refreshes could run on a schedule. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a scheduling or recurring-job capability. The Warehouse Sync material (mparticle-docs-x4, mparticle-docs-18) describes ingesting data from warehouses but never mentions a recurring schedule or cadence, so there is no basis for credit.
